SELECT requirement_id AS requirementId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM connection WHERE buyer_tenant_id = #{buyerTenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'accepted' AND requirement_id IN #{id} GROUP BY requirement_id
SELECT requirement_id AS requirementId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM connection WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'accepted' AND requirement_id IN #{id} GROUP BY requirement_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connection WHERE requirement_id = #{requirementId} AND status = 'accepted' AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE connection SET status = #{status}, reply_message = #{replyMessage}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND (supplier_tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR buyer_tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND status = 'pending' AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM connection WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (buyer_tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR supplier_tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND requirement_id IN #{rid}
SELECT FROM connection WHERE requirement_id = #{requirementId} AND (buyer_tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR supplier_tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT c.supplier_tenant_id AS supplierTenantId, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.status = 'accepted' THEN 1 END) AS connectionCount, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'accepted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'accepted' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'pending' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'rejected' END AS status FROM connection c WHERE c.buyer_tenant_id = #{buyerTenantId} AND c.supplier_tenant_id IN #{sid} AND c.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.supplier_tenant_id
mapper.update: UPDATE connection SET status = 'pending', message = #{message}, reply_message = NULL, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('rejected', 'closed') AND is_deleted = 0
